meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成首次设置,跑通核心流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚拿到 omo,不知道第一步该做什么。
copy.tagline_en: Finish first-time setup and run through the core workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just got omo and don't know the first step.

howto.what: Claude 会当首次使用 omo 的向导,依次带你走功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值测算和记忆记录等环节,并用 memory 工具把你的偏好和项目信息记下来。
howto.when: 当新用户说想开始用 omo 时触发。它只自动启动一次,之后可用 senpi --onboard 重新调起,或用 omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled 关掉自动启动。

say.text: 我想开始用 omo,带我上手
say.note: 进入功能导览,分批介绍 omo 的能力

say.text: 我之前用 Claude Code,能帮我把配置迁过来吗
say.note: 进入迁移环节,列出映射方案并等你确认

say.text: 能翻一下我以前的会话,算算缓存能省多少吗
say.note: 进入会话考古与价值测算,给出估算

howto.what_en: Claude guides a first-time omo user through the feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping and memory recording, and records durable facts about the user with memory tools. Some lanes are opt-in.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts once, and can be reopened with the senpi --onboard flag or turned off with omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo — walk me through getting started
say_en.note: Starts the feature tour, three to five highlights at a time

say_en.text: I used Claude Code before; can you migrate my setup?
say_en.note: Reads existing config, shows one plan and waits for your yes

say_en.text: Can you look through my old sessions and estimate cache savings?
say_en.note: Runs session archaeology, then quantified savings
